meaning: Basic triage only; PASS means ready for deeper assessment, not approval to quote or deploy

normalized_brief.scope: Copy approved weekly stock totals into a test spreadsheet
normalized_brief.access: Owner-approved read access and test-sheet write access
normalized_brief.data_boundary: Stock counts only; no personal data
normalized_brief.acceptance: Row totals match the source in the test environment
normalized_brief.budget: Client-approved discovery budget; no implementation quote

risk_checklist: Confirm authority and supported integration actions
Identify sensitive data and access boundaries
Verify budget, deadline and recurring usage responsibility
next_actions: Complete evidence and economics assessment before committing
